acip: RTAGS SLA, BYAS PA LA KHO NA RE, DE 'DRA'I GZHI MTHUN YONGS RDZOGS DE YOD PAR THAL, KA BA DANG 'GAL BA DANG MI 'GAL BA YANG YIN, DE DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG 'GAL BA YANG YIN, DE DANG 'BREL BA DANG MA 'BREL BA YANG YIN, DE DANG MA 'BREL BA DANG 'BREL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD PA'I PHYIR NA, 'DIR MA KHYAB, RTAGS GRUB STE, KA BA DANG 'GAL BA DE DE LTAR YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags sla, byas pa la kho na re, de 'dra'i gzhi mthun yongs rdzogs de yod par thal, ka ba dang 'gal ba dang mi 'gal ba yang yin, de dang mi 'gal ba dang 'gal ba yang yin, de dang 'brel ba dang ma 'brel ba yang yin, de dang ma 'brel ba dang 'brel ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir na, 'dir ma khyab, rtags grub ste, ka ba dang 'gal ba de de ltar yin pa'i phyir
english: The reason we've given is easy to accept. Suppose, relative to this same point, someone comes and says: It is so, that there does exist a typical example which incorporates all the conditions stated. Because there does exist one thing which is (1) something which is such that being it is not contradictory to being something which is such that being it is contradictory to being a pillar; (2) something which is such that being it is contradictory to being something which is such that being it is not contradictory to being this same thing; (3) something which does not share a relationship with something which does share a relationship with this same thing; and (4) something which does share a relationship with something which does not share a relationship with this same thing. Our answer to this is, "It doesn't necessarily follow." The reason, by the way, is itself true, for something which is such that being it is contradictory to being a pillar is just this kind of combination.
